name: dogfood-oidc-federation
description: Dogfood app v1.21-4 — a Deno + Hono self-hosted OpenID Provider (OP) that exercises the OIDC Core 1.0 + Discovery 1.0 + RFC 7591 DCR + JWKS rotation + Federation 1.0 §7 endpoint surface. Sub-Issue v1.21-4a (this state) lands the shared skeleton — OP interface, adapter split (mock via @kiwa-test/auth setupOidcEnv + real via Keycloak testcontainers), Discovery + JWKS surface, fidelity harness scaffold. Sub-Issues b/c/d layer DCR + id_token verification + Federation trust chain on top. Drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (spawns Keycloak through testcontainers, env-skip via KIWA_OIDC_ENV_MISSING) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-test/auth setupOidcEnv). Behavioural fidelity between the two drivers feeds the release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/auth -F @kiwa-test/core build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
